user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account so that I can access my personalized dashboard. I enter my email and password and click the login button to authenticate my session.
acceptance_criteria: The login form should have an input field with id 'email' for entering the user's email.
The login form should have an input field with id 'password' for entering the user's password.
The login form should have a submit button with data-test 'login-submit' that allows the user to submit the form.
